verdict.rationale: Airwallex is a financial platform that holds sensitive customer data, so an AI-training opt-out or a no-training data policy is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses AI training data use, opt-out controls, or a data-usage policy. Scoped API keys, the sandbox, and AgentOS are access and tooling features, not training-data controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
